description: Client preferences and soft constraints. These are advisory guidelines that should be followed when possible, but can be violated with proper justification.

rules.name: Target Volatility Regime
rules.description: The client prefers a moderate risk profile with an annualized volatility target between 10% and 15%.
rules.enforcement: If market volatility spikes, the Agent is expected to reduce position sizes. However, staying slightly above the range is acceptable if the Sharpe Ratio remains above 2.0.

rules.name: Portfolio Turnover Control
rules.description: To maintain a mid-to-long-term investment style, the monthly turnover rate should ideally be kept below 200%.
rules.enforcement: Higher turnover is permissible during high-regime-shift periods (e.g., black swan event) to protect capital, but excessive noise trading will be penalized.

rules.name: Thematic Sector Affinity (Strategic Tilt)
rules.description: The client has a preference for New Energy, Artificial Intelligence, and Biotechnology sectors. Ideally, these should constitute 30-50% of total equity.
rules.enforcement: The Agent may deviate to other sectors (e.g., Commodities) if technical indicators show significantly higher expected alpha, provided it explains the Opportunity Cost.

rules.name: Maximum Cash Drag Optimization
rules.description: The client prefers not to exceed 20% cash for extended periods to avoid Cash Drag on returns.
rules.enforcement: Holding high cash (>20%) is only justified if the Agent's Market Sentiment Analysis indicates a high probability of systemic downturn.

rules.name: Transaction Cost Minimization
rules.description: Prefer limit orders over market orders when possible to reduce slippage and transaction costs. Target average slippage below 0.1%.
rules.enforcement: Market orders are acceptable during urgent situations or when liquidity is high, but should be minimized.

rules.name: Risk-Adjusted Return Focus
rules.description: Prioritize strategies with Sharpe Ratio above 1.5. Higher returns at lower Sharpe are less desirable.
rules.enforcement: This is a soft preference - can be overridden for tactical opportunities, but should guide long-term strategy.
